newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell Philippines to match Petron's pump prices.
newsitem.headline: Shell Philippines to match Petron's pump prices.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp said on Friday it had aligned retail prices of its petroleum products in line with the increase in prices earlier announced by Petron Corp.
Based on wholesale posted prices, Pilipinas Shell said the adjustments are just a mere 0.0146-peso increase per litre to an average of 6.5471 pesos per litre.
Oil firms have been adjusting their prices monthly since the industry was freed from government control on February 8 this year.

Pilipinas Shell said prices of premium leaded gasoline increased to 11.67 pesos per litre from 11.27; unleaded premium gasoline to 11.28 pesos per litre from 10.88; regular gasoline to 10.39 pesos per litre from 10.19; and diesel to 7.70 pesos per litre from 7.60.
Prices of socially-sensitive products had been trimmed, the firm said.
Prices of fuel oil went down to 3.84 pesos per litre from 3.94; liquefied petroleum gas to 176 pesos per 11-kg from 183 pesos; and kerosene to 6.83 pesos per litre from 7.11 pesos.
The company cut aviation turbo to 9.278 per litre from 9.578.
The changes were made based on trends in Singapore Posted Prices, the firm said.
Pilipinas Shell is a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of Companies.
